headline: SFG @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.84 at MIL 6.05, with a projected total of 9.89. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: SFG moved +0.67 runs while MIL moved +2.24, changing the projected margin by -1.57 runs. The projected total climbed +2.91, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Coleman Crow has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.7 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Jackson Chourio, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
